title: Great e scooter experience in Seville
text: Excellent experience. Great organization. Really enjoyed.
author: rhodrig109

title: Great experience
text: Great fun. Had time to see the city and the views. Great service and hospitality as well. The scooter was low on battery so the attendant said I could exchange my scooter with another and added some time due to the swap. Really kind gesture.
author: Barbara_A

title: Abuelita & Grandson on scooters in Sevilla!!
text: This is so much fun & EASY! We loved navigating our own way around Sevilla. I am 72 & my grandson is 18. I felt like a teenager! We were able to see so much in a couple of hours. This is our lady week of a month in Spain & we have been walking A LOT every day!! Including 7 days on Camino de Santiago. It was a nice change from walking. DO IT!!
author: Lynn_M

title: Never done this before- WHY NOT give it a go?
text: Amazing value:))))) We chose this based on previous reviews and boy where they right!  It was tremendous fun and we covered far more ground than we could ever do on foot.  Andrea (the lady at the collection point) went through everything at the start and gave us the map to follow on my phone.  This was held onto the handlebars and we were off,  a bit shacky to start (we are in our late 50's and not stick insects) but we soon got the hang of it and zoomed around with ease.  We did go "Off-Piste" more than a couple of times, that made it all the more fun.  If you want to see a lot in a short tim
author: MrsAndrea_N

title: Great day!
text: Great way to see the city. Good battery, good pace. Especially useful on hot days. The city lends itself well to this mode of transport
author: 952oswinb

title: Superb for wandering around without Seville!
text: Perfect for discovering all the riches and monuments of Seville with a fast, silent and very handy means of transport!
author: janopolo

title: Any tour around Sevilla...
text:
Any tour around Sevilla is magical. For me, who would tire easily on a bike, touring on a scooter was the best!!! 
Our guide, Luis, was very knowledgeable of the history of Spain, and the story behind each historic place we visited. 
He would get excited with more Q&A.  So join the tour with inquisitiveness.
author: MAVIRGINIA_M

title: Great.
text:
Very nice people and great way to visit the main points with family
Good scooters, sufficient batteries, sending a plan to follow by email, hanging the phone on the scooter. Medium silicone hanging system, does not hold the phone sufficiently.
author: A9258DWluciet

title: Seville City Tour with eScooter
text: Great way to explore a city with 2 teenagers in temperatures of up to 43 degrees😅. Kids had fun and parents had fun too! You get a gps route on your mobile phone which leads along all the main sights of Seville on paths approved for e Scooter. Worth every penny, anytime again!
author: huesair

title: Discover Seville by E-step!
text:
Great fun! You can see a lot in 2 hours and decide what you want to see next.
Tip: check the scooter well in advance that everything is secure and functioning properly.
author: IvarM91
